procedures.purpose: Sensor quick test and heater check

steps.title: Disconnect power and discharge HV

steps.title: Continue after sensor quick test
steps.body: Sensor quick test entered (Auto Defrost + Popcorn hold). Continue with fault interpretation below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: §4-14 SENSOR TEST (QUICK TEST) — Auto Defrost and Popcorn pads.

steps.title: Quick test display 15–185?
steps.body: Standby: hold Auto Defrost + Popcorn — normal range 15–185. ≥213 = open/unplugged; <6 = shorted.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 15-185 Normal; 213 or Higher failed; Less then 6 shorted.

steps.title: Sensor connector seated at CN250?
steps.body: Inspect gas sensor connector and housing in vent area (top left cavity).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect gas sensor connector and housing in vent area (top left cavity).

steps.title: Reseat sensor connector
steps.body: Connect sensor wire properly and retest quick test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connect sensor wire properly and retest quick test.

steps.title: Sensor heater terminals (H) ~30 Ω
steps.body: Only Black and Red heater leads — do NOT ohm White/Orange sensor terminals.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Only heater terminals (H; Black and Red leads) can be checked with ohmmeter (30Ω).

steps.title: Replace humidity sensor
steps.body: Replace cooking sensor assembly.

steps.title: Replace sensor — heater failed
steps.body: Replace sensor — heater out of spec.

steps.title: Replace PCB
steps.body: Sensor circuit OK — replace main PCB if fault persists (C-10).
